name.description: Short name displayed on the Dispatch Calendar and calendar invitation.

responses[].description: Form entry responses used to pre-populate the submission.

responses[].entryGuid.description: Entry GUID, an alternative to entry ID documented for immediate dispatches.

responses[].multiKey.description: Looped value reference; required for looped forms.

scheduledAt.description: Required for scheduled and recurring dispatches; example: 12/1/2024 8:00:00 AM.

scheduledEnd.description: Required for scheduled and recurring dispatches; example: 12/1/2024 12:00:00 PM.

reminderInterval.description: Minutes before the dispatch event to send a reminder. Scheduled-dispatch documentation lists this as optional and also as required.

sendCalendarInvite.description: Send a calendar invitation when true.

sendNotification.description: Send a mobile push notification when true; documented for immediate dispatches.

noFormAssignment.description: Allow creation without the assignee being assigned to the form when true.

repeatEndsOn.description: Required when repeat ends option is ends_on; format MM/DD/YYYY.

repeatOccurrences.description: Required when repeat ends option is ends_after.
